effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC from their wallet to the vault (safeTransferFrom in enter).
The vault mints PurintaUSDC shares to `onBehalf`; the vault computes the share count from the share price (previewDeposit), after it accrues fees.
The vault forwards the deposited USDC to its liquidity adapter. This does not change what the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit 20 USDC for the onBehalf address, with the share ticker PurintaUSDC and the share recipient shown, but not the number of shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many PurintaUSDC shares the recipient receives, and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` The share price comes from storage and adapters. Case 0: signer receives 20 PurintaUSDC (in); the screen shows only 'Share ticker: PurintaUSDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the computed share count. The function has no minShares parameter.

cases.notes: 20 USDC out is shown right. 20 PurintaUSDC in: the asset and the recipient are shown, the amount is not, because the contract computes it.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns PurintaUSDC shares from `onBehalf`; the vault computes the count with previewWithdraw, rounded up.
If the caller is not `onBehalf`, the vault spends the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` by that share count.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw an exact USDC amount to the receiver, with the owner whose shares pay for it, but not how many shares the vault burns.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many PurintaUSDC shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` and exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. Case 2: signer sends 77.073196 PurintaUSDC (out); the screen shows only 'Withdraw exactly: 77.378214 USDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the computed share count. The function has no maxShares parameter. The 'Owner' field already shows whose shares the vault burns.

cases.notes: 77.378214 USDC in to the signer is shown right. The reader saw the balance drop but stated it in USDC; the burn of 77.07 shares is not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` PurintaUSDC from `onBehalf`.
If the caller is not `onBehalf`, the vault spends the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` by `shares`.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the vault computes the amount with previewRedeem, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 20 PurintaUSDC to the receiver, with the owner shown, but nothing says that USDC comes back or how much.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets; the sibling mint format names it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` with asset = USDC (constructor _asset 0xA0b8…eB48). The redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. Case 3 reader: 'probably USDC … Whether the underlying asset is really USDC'.
findings.fix: Add a field { "label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker" }. Change the interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC the receiver gets, and there is no minimum received.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Case 3: signer receives 20.042641 USDC (in); no field states an amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the computed amount. The function has no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: 20 PurintaUSDC out is shown right. 20.042641 USDC in: nothing on the screen names the asset or the amount. The reader guessed USDC.

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault; the vault computes the amount with previewMint, rounded up, and there is no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` PurintaUSDC to `onBehalf`.
The vault forwards the deposited USDC to its liquidity adapter. This does not change what the signer gets.
formats.shown: Mint 1 PurintaUSDC for the onBehalf address, with 'Deposit asset: USDC' as a field, but no USDC amount and no word in the sentence that USDC is paid.

findings.title: mint intent says 'Mint' and does not say the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: Descriptor mint: intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". VaultV2.enter: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets);`. Case 1: the signer sends 1 USDC (out); the sentence reads 'Mint 1 PurintaUSDC for 0x…dEaD'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for shares" and the interpolatedIntent to "Deposit USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}".

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer, and there is no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. Case 1: signer sends 1 USDC (out); the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the computed amount. The function has no maxAssets parameter.

cases.notes: USDC out: the asset is shown as a field, the amount is not. The reader saw that the shares go to 0x…dEaD. That transfer is not a signer effect.
